parameter_matrix.note: Check PCB land pattern & height profile.
A part wins only if its operating Vin range strictly encompasses the counterpart on both ends.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.

parameter_matrix.part_b_value: Ceramic OK · >=1 µF · Low-ESR MLCC compatible
parameter_matrix.note: Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: CRITICAL PACKAGE MISMATCH: AP7361C-33E-13 uses SOT-223-3 (3-pin, SOT223 (E)) while AP7365-33YG-13 uses SOT-89-3 (3-pin, Y (SOT89)); PCB footprint redesign is mandatory.

CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (VIN vs VOUT), Pin 3 (VOUT vs VIN). Soldering AP7365-33YG-13 onto a AP7361C-33E-13 footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.
CAUTION OUTPUT CAPACITANCE: Minimum Cout differs by 2.2x (AP7361C-33E-13: 2.2 µF p.1 vs AP7365-33YG-13: 1 µF p.1); account for MLCC DC-bias derating.
HIGH LOAD CURRENT DERATING: AP7365-33YG-13 supplies up to 600 mA (p.3) compared to AP7361C-33E-13 at 1000 mA (p.4); confirm peak inrush and thermal dissipation margin.
CAUTION LIFECYCLE STATUS (NRND): AP7365-33YG-13 is flagged NRND by Diodes Incorporated; do not design into new production layouts — evaluate Active alternatives.
engineering_verdict: AP7361C-33E-13 (Diodes Incorporated, SOT-223-3) and AP7365-33YG-13 (Diodes Incorporated, SOT-89-3) are NOT drop-in interchangeable (Level 3 PCB Layout / Circuit Change Required) due to package/footprint mismatch; pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (VIN vs VOUT), Pin 3 (VOUT vs VIN). Specific pin conflicts: Pin 1 (VIN vs VOUT), Pin 3 (VOUT vs VIN). Under a representative 5 V → 3.3 V rail at 150 mA (255 mW), estimated self-heating is ΔTj ≈ 28.1 °C on AP7361C-33E-13 (θJA 110 °C/W) vs 33.9 °C on AP7365-33YG-13 (θJA 133 °C/W), while quiescent draw spans a 1.7x ratio (60 µA (p.5) vs 35 µA (p.3)). Primary bench gotchas to watch: AP7361C-33E-13 "CRITICAL E vs. ER Suffix Pinout Trap — AP7361C-33E-13 is INCOMPATIBLE with 1117 Pads" (p.15) and AP7365-33YG-13 "NRND Lifecycle Banner on Page 1 — Diodes Inc Directs New Designs to AP7366" (p.1). BOM decision: Choose AP7361C-33E-13 when load current exceeds 600 mA (up to 1000 mA) or lower package θJA (110 °C/W) is needed for thermal margin; choose AP7365-33YG-13 when battery sleep budget demands 35 µA Iq. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.1) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
